# SEOLinkBuildings

> Guest-post and backlink marketplace connecting advertisers with verified publishers across Europe and major English-speaking markets.

## Product
SEOLinkBuildings (seolinkbuildings.com) is a two-sided marketplace for buying and selling editorial guest-post placements. Advertisers browse a catalog of publisher sites, fund a EUR wallet, assign approved articles, and track orders to live URL. Publishers list sites, fulfil placement tasks, and withdraw earnings.

Public marketing site languages: English (default), German (/de), French (/fr), Dutch (/nl). Logged-in SaaS dashboard is English.

## Pricing (snapshot)
- Marketplace placements: priced per publisher listing; public pages state placements start from a low EUR amount (catalog after login).
- New advertisers: €20 welcome credit for first orders (spend-only, not withdrawable).
- Managed Digital PR packages (monthly):
  - Starter: €499
  - Growth: €1,499
  - Authority: €2,799

- Publishers / site owners selling placements on approved inventory
